description: Portable Windows toolkit for PC technicians with profile backup and restore, diagnostics, application management, disk tools, network utilities, and USB imaging.
notes: The official Windows x64 ZIP is installer-free; extract and run sak_utility.exe from a writable folder.
Settings, chats, and reports are stored in the data directory beside the executable and are preserved by Scoop.
Some disk, partition, and system-repair operations request Administrator rights when invoked.
